scripts.build: esbuild src/autocomplete.ts src/*.json src/options/* src/*.css --bundle --sourcemap --loader:.json=copy --loader:.html=copy --loader:.js=copy --loader:.css=copy --outdir=dist/ && web-ext build --source-dir=dist/ --artifacts-dir=dist/artifacts/ --overwrite-dest
scripts.build-and-sign: npm run build && cd dist/ && web-ext sign --channel listed -v --artifacts-dir=artifacts/ --amo-metadata=../metadata.json
